name: airo-doffy-fm-c6-bs32
description: Cluster6 batch-size-32 fm training with 1 GPU, 4 CPUs, W&B, and HF upload

command: set -Eeuo pipefail; stage_dir=/tmp/airo_baseline_cluster6_stage; ready_file=${stage_dir}/READY; for stage_attempt in $(seq 1 900); do if [ -f "${ready_file}" ]; then exec bash "${stage_dir}/run-baseline-policy-single-cluster6-bs32.sh"; fi; sleep 2; done; echo 'Timed out waiting for staged inputs' >&2; exit 2
